title: Exquisite and well worth a visit 🇪🇸
text: Very accommodating, attractive and friendly staff at the entrance. What a truly significant building. A Renaissance/Baroque exquisite architectural building that was absolutely breathtaking, taking almost 190 years to build. The actual pillars are several metres wide. You cannot believe the work that has went into this, more than equaling the work in Rome( everyone was wanting to be more superior to the other, I assume) You will not be disappointed. From the outside it looks pretty insignificant, but go inside and see the splendour of the immense detail and symmetry, it is truly magical!
author: Global650001

title: Excellent Experience
text: Our tour guide Marta was incredibly knowledgeable and deeply passionate about everything she shared. Excellent experience
author: janweb

title: Essential guide experience!
text:
Our guide was extremely knowledgeable of all aspects of the Cathedral and Granada facts.  Very insightful and educational! 
Highly recommend a guide as there is so much to learn that is not otherwise explained . If you are in a hurry - 7€ gets you into the Cathedral- did not seem to be a problem with availability nor at the Royal Chapel
author: Passenger18889790187

title: Alberto’s tour was a gift
text:
Alberto was an excellent guide.  His English was perfect, and his knowledge was very deep.    He brought all the things that he showed us to life with the amazing history in the stories in the background he provided.

I would highly recommend him to anyone seeking a wonderful tour
author: joey5326

title: Excellent tour of the Alhambra.
text: We had a walking tour with Pedro and it was fantastic. He was truly passionate about his work and the history of Grenada plus the Alhambra. One of the better tours I’ve had throughout Europe. I recommend requesting him when booking your tour.
